title: HG-RAG：面向结构化知识图谱的层级引导检索增强生成
summary: HG-RAG是一种层级引导的RAG框架，通过在层级知识图谱上进行图遍历，为语言模型提供结构化上下文。其检索流程先解析查询中的命名实体锚点，再向上、横向、向下扩展上下文。在三个规模（18-800节点）和四种查询类型上的评估表明，HG-RAG在层级、关系和多跳推理任务上持续优于平面基线，同时减少幻觉并保持局部连贯性。
summary_en: HG-RAG is a hierarchy-guided RAG framework that performs graph traversal over a hierarchical knowledge graph to deliver structured context to an LLM. It resolves a named entity anchor from the query, then expands context upward, laterally, and downward. Evaluated across three world scales and four query types, HG-RAG consistently outperforms flat baselines on hierarchical, relational, and multi-hop reasoning tasks while reducing hallucination.
